patterns.explanation_ar: Usually تعني حدوث الفعل في معظم الأوقات، وليس في كل مرة. تأتي قبل الفعل الأساسي، ولكن بعد am/is/are.
patterns.explanation_en: Usually describes something that happens most of the time, but not always.
patterns.contrast_ar: Always = دائمًا، Usually = عادةً، Sometimes = أحيانًا.
patterns.contrast_en: Usually means in most cases, not every time; its position is normally before a main verb and after be.

patterns.title: دائمًا
patterns.level_review: Provisional editorial range; later examples include supported A2–B1 clauses, not certification.
patterns.explanation_ar: Always تعني دائمًا أو في كل مرة، وقد تُستخدم للمبالغة بحسب السياق. تأتي عادةً قبل الفعل الرئيسي وبعد be.
patterns.explanation_en: Always means every time. Put it before most main verbs.
patterns.contrast_ar: Always أقوى من Usually: دائمًا مقابل عادةً.
patterns.contrast_en: Always indicates every time, whereas usually allows more exceptions.

patterns.title: غالبًا / كثيرًا
patterns.level_review: Provisional editorial range; later examples include supported A2–B1 clauses, not certification.
patterns.explanation_ar: Often تعني أن الفعل يتكرر كثيرًا، ولكن ليس بالضرورة معظم الأيام. وهي عادةً أقل قوة من usually.
patterns.explanation_en: Often means many times, though not every time.
patterns.contrast_ar: Usually = في معظم المرات؛ Often = في مرات كثيرة؛ Sometimes = أحيانًا.
patterns.contrast_en: Often describes frequent occurrences without a fixed numerical percentage.

wrong_pair.reason_ar: Often تعني أن الفعل يتكرر كثيرًا، ولكن ليس بالضرورة معظم الأيام. وهي عادةً أقل قوة من usually.

patterns.title: كنتُ
patterns.explanation_ar: نستخدم I was لبيان حالة أو دور أو مكان في وقت ماضٍ. لا تثبت was وحدها أن الحالة انتهت نهائيًا أو أنها لم تعد صحيحة الآن.
patterns.explanation_en: Use I was to place a state, role, or location at a past time. Was alone does not establish whether it remains true today.
patterns.contrast_ar: I was في الماضي، بينما I am للحاضر.
patterns.contrast_en: Use was for a past state with I; use am for a present state. Was is followed by a complement here, not a second finite verb.

patterns.contrast_en: Went is the irregular past of go. Use to before most destination nouns, but not before home in went home.

patterns.title: نسيتُ أن
patterns.explanation_ar: نستخدم forgot to لفعل مقصود أو مطلوب لم نؤده في الوقت المقصود، وقد نتذكره ونؤديه لاحقًا. يلي to الفعل الأساسي.
patterns.explanation_en: Use forgot to plus a base verb for an intended action you failed to perform at the intended time. You may remember and do it later.
patterns.contrast_ar: I forgot to call = لم أتصل؛ I remembered calling = أتذكر أنني اتصلت.
patterns.contrast_en: Forgot to do means the intended action was not performed. Forgot doing means losing the memory of an action that happened, a different meaning.

patterns.contrast_ar: When I arrived, she smiled حدثان؛ When I arrived, she was reading حدث جارٍ.

patterns.explanation_en: Use won't to say a future action will not happen or to make a negative promise.
patterns.contrast_ar: I won't go للمستقبل؛ I didn't go للماضي.
patterns.contrast_en: Won't means will not. It can describe a future negative prediction, a promise or a refusal; it is not the past negative didn't.

patterns.contrast_en: Think introduces a complete clause, often with optional that. It usually marks an opinion or estimate, rather than guaranteeing that the statement is true.

patterns.contrast_en: Excuse me often gets attention before an interruption; I'm sorry commonly apologizes for a mistake. Excuse me can also apologize for a minor disturbance.

patterns.source_form: sentence. However, contrasting sentence
patterns.title: ومع ذلك / لكن
patterns.explanation_ar: تربط however جملتين مستقلتين في سياق أهدأ أو أكثر رسمية؛ يمكن أن تأتي بعد فاصلة منقوطة ولا نربط جملتين مستقلتين بفاصلة وحدها قبلها. عند وصل جملتين مستقلتين نضع نقطة أو فاصلة منقوطة قبل however، لا فاصلة وحدها في الكتابة القياسية المدروسة.
patterns.explanation_en: Use however to introduce contrast across sentences, often after a period or semicolon. When linking independent clauses, put a full stop or semicolon before however rather than a comma alone.
patterns.contrast_ar: The room is small, but useful جملة واحدة؛ The room is small. However, it works well جملتان.
patterns.contrast_en: Use a full stop or semicolon before however when linking independent clauses; a comma alone creates a comma splice in the formal standard taught here.
